title: 义务教育教科书·英语（清华）四年级上册

sentences.cn: 铃响了，他们的商店开门了。
sentences.en: The bell rings and their shop is open.

sentences.cn: 快点，把瓶子和碗放到桌子上。
sentences.en: Hurry up and put the bottle and the bowl on the table.

sentences.cn: 他们的农场就在这条街上。
sentences.en: Their farm is on this street.

sentences.cn: 把苹果切开，用绳子把盒子系上。
sentences.en: Cut the apple and tie the box with a string.

sentences.cn: 我们出去找条虫子吧。
sentences.en: Let’s go out and look for a worm.

sentences.cn: 我今天要去医生那里做检查。
sentences.en: I have a check-up with the doctor today.

sentences.cn: 熊猫在花园里吃竹子。
sentences.en: The panda eats bamboo in the garden.

sentences.cn: 一只蝴蝶在鹿的后面。
sentences.en: A butterfly is behind the deer.

sentences.cn: 松鼠把坚果放进洞里。
sentences.en: The squirrel puts a nut in the hole.

sentences.cn: 我要去田里收桃子和梨。
sentences.en: I’ll collect peaches and pears in the field.

sentences.cn: 蚂蚁能爬进那个小洞。
sentences.en: The ant can crawl into the small hole.

sentences.cn: 你能找到去花园的路吗？
sentences.en: Can you find the way to the garden?

sentences.cn: 用蜡笔画一只蝴蝶吧。
sentences.en: Use a crayon to draw a butterfly.

sentences.cn: 蜜蜂从花里采到花蜜。
sentences.en: The bee gets nectar from the flower.

sentences.cn: 我会找到我的玩具熊。
sentences.en: I will find my teddy bear.

sentences.cn: 我们学习有关花和蜜蜂的知识。
sentences.en: We learn about flowers and bees.

sentences.cn: 坐在椅子上听我说。
sentences.en: Sit on the chair and listen to me.

sentences.cn: 天很热，所以我打开风扇。
sentences.en: It is hot, so I turn on the fan.

sentences.cn: 请用布把西瓜盖起来。
sentences.en: Please cover the watermelon with a cloth.

sentences.cn: 我要一个热狗和一杯冷饮。
sentences.en: I want a hot dog and a cold drink.

sentences.cn: 拉绳子，但别尖叫。
sentences.en: Pull the rope, but do not scream.

sentences.cn: 别哭，也别对妹妹大喊。
sentences.en: Do not cry and do not yell at your sister.

sentences.cn: 他很冷，开始哆嗦起来。
sentences.en: He is cold and starts to shiver.

sentences.cn: 搓搓手，笑一笑。
sentences.en: Rub your hands together and smile.

sentences.cn: 我们在树下休息一下，聊聊天。
sentences.en: Let’s rest under the tree and talk.

sentences.cn: 宝宝看着我，开始打哈欠。
sentences.en: The baby looks at me and starts to yawn.

sentences.cn: 雨点重重地打在屋顶上，但我们很开心。
sentences.en: The rain pounds on the roof, but we are happy.

sentences.cn: 运动之后，我常常吃点小吃。
sentences.en: After sports, I often eat a snack.

sentences.cn: 吃东西前先洗手。
sentences.en: Wash your hands before you eat.

sentences.cn: 我的身体很健康，因为我一直坚持运动。
sentences.en: My body is healthy because I keep moving.

sentences.cn: 健康很重要，所以我吃各种不同的蔬菜。
sentences.en: Health is important, so I eat different vegetables.

sentences.cn: 我喜欢胡萝卜、豆子和卷心菜。
sentences.en: I like carrots, beans and cabbage.

sentences.cn: 往汤里放一个洋葱和一个土豆。
sentences.en: Put an onion and a potato in the soup.

sentences.cn: 奶酪和饼干是我最爱的小吃。
sentences.en: Cheese and cookies are my favourite snack.

sentences.cn: 牙医说我的牙齿没问题。
sentences.en: The dentist says my teeth are fine.

sentences.cn: 如果你生病了，就去看医生。
sentences.en: If you are ill, go and see a doctor.

sentences.cn: 没有水植物会死，有了水它们才会生长。
sentences.en: Plants die without water, but they grow with it.

sentences.cn: 很少有孩子喜欢这项运动。
sentences.en: Few kids like this sport.

sentences.cn: 你喜欢哪种运动？
sentences.en: What kind of sport do you like?

sentences.cn: 羽毛球和乒乓球都很有趣。
sentences.en: Badminton and table tennis are interesting.

sentences.cn: 放学后我也打网球。
sentences.en: I also play tennis after school.

sentences.cn: 我去看望奶奶，她帮我检查作业。
sentences.en: I visit my grandma and she checks my homework.

sentences.cn: 我困了，所以早早去睡觉。
sentences.en: I am sleepy, so I go to bed early.

sentences.cn: 我爸爸在一家大商店工作。
sentences.en: My father works in a big shop.
